cases.name: The add-on's own test suite
cases.result: 338 checks passed, 0 failed (node test.mjs in the add-on's test folder; 2026-10-28, headless, on the build server). It covers symbols, wires, cross-references, sheets, the four lists, installation plans, circuits, cable routes, the panel schedule, checks, DWG/DXF round trips and the sample project.

cases.name: Balancing a panel
cases.result: Four single-phase circuits and one three-phase circuit, all on L1: balancing gives L1 4,000 W, L2 3,000 W and L3 3,900 W, and the unbalance matches the largest phase difference divided by the mean phase load (test t-reports).

cases.name: The sample project
cases.result: Built and checked with no errors; its terminal plan (-X1:1 to 4, from the contactor to the motor), its cable list (three cores of -W1) and the contactor's six listed contacts match what the drawing holds, and it saves and reads back (test t-sample).
